# 2023_Q33

## Question

Autopsy method removing organs en masse from tongue to prostate?

## Options

- A) Virchow
- B) Rokitansky
- C) Ghon
- D) Letulle ✅

## Your Answer

C) Ghon

## Correct Answer

D) Letulle

## Key Fact (generated by LLM)

The Letulle method is an autopsy technique where organs are removed en masse from the tongue to the prostate, allowing for a more comprehensive examination of the thoracic and abdominal cavities. This approach is particularly useful in certain cases, such as forensic autopsies. The Letulle method is distinct from other autopsy techniques, such as the Virchow method, which involves removing organs individually. It provides a more detailed view of the anatomical relationships between organs.
